purpose: Compatibility only; no task quality, benchmark tasks, holdout material, or harness ranking.
selection: After every scheduled slot resolves, select first fully eligible model in models order; test both even if first is eligible.

wire.authorization: Bearer from key file at explicit execution only; never persisted
wire.sessionHeader: x-opencode-session: opaque UUID fixed independently per model
wire.transportAmendment: New model-neutral User-Agent differs from historical DeepSeek study tag; same for both models, and required unchanged for any later alternate-model native stratum.

titleMessages.title1: Organize a weekly checklist for watering indoor plants.
titleMessages.title2: Help me plan a reminder to renew a library membership.
titleMessages.title3: Create a packing checklist for a weekend train trip.

tool.name: echo_value
tool.description: Return the supplied compatibility marker unchanged. This tool has no external side effects.
tool.prompt: Call echo_value exactly once with value COMPAT_READY. After receiving its result, reply with only the returned value.

eligibility.titleFormat: HTTP 200, finish_reason stop, exact schema object with only a nonempty string title, no tool_calls; at most native 12 whitespace-separated words. No semantic quality score.
eligibility.toolInit: HTTP 200, finish_reason tool_calls, exactly one function call to echo_value with nonempty ID and exact object {value:COMPAT_READY}; preserve actual assistant reasoning_content and tool_calls in followup.
eligibility.toolFollowup: HTTP 200, finish_reason stop, no tool_calls, content trims to exact COMPAT_READY after actual deterministic tool result.
eligibility.mandatoryUsage: Every actual response has nonnegative safe-integer prompt_tokens and completion_tokens; completion_tokens <= 4096; reported total_tokens, if present, must equal their sum. Reasoning count, if present, must be a nonnegative safe integer <= completion_tokens and is not added again.
eligibility.cachedUsage: Unknown or invalid cached-token subcounter is recorded separately and does not invalidate otherwise valid mandatory usage.
eligibility.modelIdentity: Every actual response model exactly equals requested model; no name guessing or substitution accepted.
eligibility.errors: Every HTTP non-200, transport failure, malformed response, finish reason mismatch, or missing/invalid mandatory usage makes the model ineligible. Preserve raw sanitized response and all reported usage on failures.
eligibility.dependency: Malformed/failed initial tool response skips only its dependent followup with explicit ineligible evidence; independent titles and other model still attempted.
eligibility.completion: No selection until all 10 slots are durably accounted for, including skips. Crash leaves incomplete evidence and admission cannot be reused.

executionAdmission.restartPolicy: No resume, retry, or new output directory; a durable wx claim is created before key reading or sends.

limitations: Raw compatibility requests reproduce exact pinned native title prompt/schema and shared effective controls, not the complete stock Hermes lifecycle or its fallback behavior.
Three successful title requests cannot prove future native whole-batch compatibility.
A separate later native model stratum must be preregistered; these probes never replace or rescore DeepSeek outcomes.
Request timeouts can leave provider-side usage unknown; no retries are allowed and all such uncertainty remains ineligibility.
Maximum generated tokens is a requested cap, not model capacity, price guarantee, or proven absence of provider overrun.
